findings.issue: Furigana/reading attribute renders the katakana loanword ドア in hiragana (どあ). The orthographic kana reading must keep loanwords in katakana — the same file does this correctly elsewhere (さんぽのついでにパンをかった keeps パン).

findings.issue: 一時 (いちじ) is glossed only as 'uma hora', which in pt-BR reads first as a one-hour duration (= 一時間). The word means 'uma hora' no sentido de 1h do relógio / 'temporariamente'; the gloss invites the classic 一時 vs 一時間 error.
findings.suggested: <vocab ref="vocab:一時"/> 'uma hora (1h do relógio); temporariamente';
